thread:
jessica (People Ops): Thanks everyone for coming to the town hall. I'm dropping a quick follow-up thread for any leftover Qs on promotions, comp timing, and the 401k note. Ask below and we'll loop in the right folks.

tom (Eng Manager): Quick one — for people who hit promo eligibility in Nov but were out on leave in Dec, do they get considered in this cycle or next?

jessica (People Ops): Good Q. If the manager submitted calibration notes before the freeze (Dec 15), they stay in this cycle. If not, we usually defer to next cycle. Ping me with names and I'll confirm.

kevin (IC): Is there an appeal window after manager comp letters go out? saw in slides but fuzzy on date.

maya (People Ops): Yes — there is a 10-business-day window for calibration appeals. It's for factual errors (e.g., wrong comp docs, missing promo approval), not re-arguing level assessments. We'll publish the appeal form tomorrow.

tom (Eng Manager): Where will managers find the comp letters / template?

jessica (People Ops): Letters will be in the Manager Toolkit doc (link below). Example message and template are under "Manager comms".

hr-bot: https://intranet.redwood/example-manager-toolkit (internal link)

kevin (IC): Another: we had a dev on a performance plan that closed in Sept — eligible now for promo?

maya (People Ops): If the improvement plan was closed and manager attests to sustained performance for 3+ months before cutoff, they can be considered. Please attach the closure note when you submit.

alice (CEO): One ask — for teams with tight headcount, we want managers to prioritize leveling/promo fairness over immediate backfills where possible. I'll discuss with hiring.

tom (Eng Manager): noted, thanks. Small practical: when do comp letters actually go out? end of week?

jessica (People Ops): Target is Friday EOD for manager emails; IC letters go out next Monday. We'll push earlier if approvals finish.

kevin (IC): About 401k matching question from Q&A — do we change the match timing for mid-cycle hires?

maya (People Ops): No change to match cadence. New hires become eligible after 30 days per plan docs. For retroactive issues (if payroll missed a match), submit a payroll ticket and cc people-ops; we'll escalate.

kevin (IC): thanks. Also, will there be a retro bump for promo backdating?

jessica (People Ops): We do not backdate base salary increases beyond the cycle cutoff. We can apply a retroactive bonus in exceptional approved cases — please route those through your HRBP.

tom (Eng Manager): For managers who need calibration help, can we book a quick sync with People Ops?

maya (People Ops): Yes. I'm opening 30-min office hours tomorrow 10–12 and Thursday 3–5. Book via my calendar link (I'll post it here in a minute).

jessica (People Ops): Posting two links: Manager Toolkit (communications + templates): ```https://intranet.redwood/manager-toolkit```. Appeal form (live tomorrow): ```https://intranet.redwood/appeals-form```.

kevin (IC): appreciate it. one last tiny ask — salary bands spreadsheet? public to managers?

maya (People Ops): Managers have access to bands for compensation decisions. Individual salaries remain private. If you need view, DM me and I'll confirm access. :thumbsup:

jessica (People Ops): Thanks folks — keep the questions coming here. I'll update thread once appeals form is live and when letters go out.

hr-bot: :calendar: Reminder — town hall recording and slides are in #general (pinned).
